title: MedPlex: Deep Vision-Language Co-Adaptation for Clinically Grounded Medical Segmentation
abstract: arXiv:2608.13690v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Medical image segmentation is still largely treated as a vision-only problem, although clinical interpretation often relies on textual knowledge of anatomy, location, appearance, and surrounding context. Existing text-guided segmentation methods within the Vision-Language Model (VLM) paradigm often use language only as a late conditioning signal, limiting its influence on visual representation learning. We introduce MedPlex (Medical Plexus of Vision and Language), an end-to-end VLM framework that makes text guidance a continuous, clinically grounded component of segmentation learning. Through Bi-Fusion (Bidirectional Fusion), visual and textual representations evolve jointly across the encoding hierarchy. MedPlex further introduces class-level and region-level concept alignment to organize the shared representation at complementary granularities. translated_title: MedPlex：面向临床医学分割的深度视觉-语言协同适应
translated_abstract: 医学图像分割在很大程度上仍被视为一个纯视觉问题，尽管临床解读通常依赖于解剖、位置、外观和周围环境的文本知识。在视觉-语言模型（VLM）范式中，现有的文本引导分割方法往往仅将语言用作后期条件信号，限制了其对视觉表示学习的影响。我们提出了MedPlex（医学视觉与语言丛），这是一个端到端的VLM框架，使文本指导成为分割学习中持续、临床基础的组成部分。通过双向融合（Bi-Fusion），视觉和文本表示在编码层次结构中共同演化。MedPlex进一步引入了类别级和区域级概念对齐，以互补的粒度组织共享表示。类别级对齐将每个解剖目标锚定到聚合的临床概念原型上。
tldr: MedPlex通过双向融合和分层概念对齐，将临床文本知识持续嵌入医学图像分割过程，实现了视觉与语言表示的协同演化，显著提升了分割的临床基础性。
en_tdlr: MedPlex embeds clinical textual knowledge continuously into medical image segmentation via bidirectional fusion and hierarchical concept alignment, enabling co-evolution of visual and linguistic representations for clinically grounded segmentation.
